In [[geometry]], the '''gyrate bidiminished rhombicosidodecahedron''' is one of the [[Johnson solid]]s ({{math|''J''{{sub|82}}}}).
[[File:J82 gyrate bidiminished rhombicosidodecahedron.stl|thumb|3D model of a gyrate bidiminished rhombicosidodecahedron]]
{{Johnson solid}}

It can be constructed as a [[rhombicosidodecahedron]] with two non-opposing [[pentagonal cupola]]e ({{math|''J''{{sub|5}}}}) removed and a third is rotated 36 degrees. Related Johnson solids are:
* The [[diminished rhombicosidodecahedron]] ({{math|''J''{{sub|76}}}}) where one cupola is removed,
* The [[parabidiminished rhombicosidodecahedron]] ({{math|''J''{{sub|80}}}}) where two opposing cupolae are removed,
* The [[metabidiminished rhombicosidodecahedron]] ({{math|''J''{{sub|81}}}}) where two non-opposing cupolae are removed,
* And the [[tridiminished rhombicosidodecahedron]] ({{math|''J''{{sub|83}}}}) where three cupolae are removed.
